# My plan for this year

*Sitting on the stool outside the house, thinking about what to do with the 9 mu this year...*

I've been farming this land for twenty years. My father grew cotton here, and I grow cotton here. With four mouths at home — me, the wife, the boy, and my mother — and the boy helping with construction work in town when he can, the cash has to come from somewhere. That's what cotton is for.

Let me think about how to split the land. Cotton is the money crop, so most of it goes there — about 5 and a half mu. Then 2 and a half mu for maize, mostly for the pigs and some for us, and 1 mu of mungbean on that sandy strip near the drainage ditch because it doesn't mind poor soil and the wife uses it for porridge and we sell some at the village market.

**Cotton** — I plant in late April once the ground warms up, after Guyu (谷雨). I buy the Bt cotton seed from the agri-shop in town, about 80 yuan a bag covers one mu. Before planting I plow in one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that's the 15-15-15 kind, fifty jin — no, fifty kilograms. Then when the flowers start coming I topdress urea, about 15 kg per mu. Old Wang next door puts down more but his land is bigger and he has the money for it. Me, I put what I can afford. I lay plastic film for warmth and weeds, that's another cost but it helps.

Watering — I water twice from the tube well if the rains are short. Once when it's squaring, once when the bolls are forming. That pump costs money every hour so I don't run it if I don't have to. And cotton, aiya, the spraying — bollworm, aphids, spider mites when it's hot. I spray four or five times through the season. I hire one or two people in October for the picking because the wife and I alone can't keep up with the three picks.

If the weather is decent I should get around 230 kg of lint per mu — maybe 700 kg of seed cotton. That's what I got two years ago. Last year was less because of that wet spell in July.

**Maize** — I do spring maize since I don't have wheat to come off first. Plant late April around the same time as the cotton, hybrid seed from the shop, nothing fancy. About 40 kg compound at planting, top up with urea when it's knee-high. One watering usually does it, mainly I rely on the rain. Spray herbicide once after emergence and maybe one round for corn borer. My maize usually gives 450 kg/mu, good enough for the pigs and family grain.

**Mungbean** — plant end of May on the 1 mu patch. I save my own seed from last year, no seed cost. Mungbean makes its own nitrogen so I don't fertilize much, maybe a little compound if I have leftover. No irrigation, hand-weed once or twice. Usually 100 kg/mu, sometimes less if it's too dry. Easy crop, low cost. Good insurance.

Total I'll spend around 3000 yuan on inputs this year. I keep a little cash back because you never know — the pump could break, or the cotton could need another spray if pests get bad.
